features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attack rolls score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Advantage on Initiative rolls and Strength (Athletics) checks; immediately after a Critical Hit you can move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

effects.reason: movement rider on a crit event

features.name: Evocation Savant
features.description: Add two Wizard Evocation spells of level 2 or lower to your spellbook for free, and one more free Evocation spell whenever you gain a new level of spell slots.

effects.reason: adds free records to a per-character spellbook, with a level-gated choice at each new slot level

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: When you miss with a cantrip attack roll or the target succeeds on its saving throw, the target takes half the cantrip's damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect.
